breakdown.description: The pipe is simultaneously described as horizontal/same elevation and having a 15 m elevation difference (contradictory geometry).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the contradiction. The original prompt stated the pipe was both horizontal (same elevation) and had a 15m elevation difference. The generated specification removed the contradictory 'horizontal' and 'same elevation' descriptions, and only included the '15 meter elevation increase from inlet to outlet,' which aligns perfectly with the ground truth's resolution.
